household.title: Three legged headrest made from one piece of wood.
Lid for quiver (see 1992.19.71 .1). Moulded cap of hide with circular section, still with some brown hair. For associated arrows see 1992.19.71 .2 - .7 [BS [OPS move] 13/10/2017]
Three-legged stool carved from a single piece of wood. [JC [OPS Move] 11/4/2017]
Carved wooden stool with three legs. The seat of the stool is heart-shaped and the each leg extends out from the seat and curves downwards towards a bulbous foot. [RH [OPS Move] 10/4/2017]

Three-legged headrest made from one piece of wood. The seat is narrow, long and slightly convex. One cylindrical leg extends down from one end of the seat, two more extend down and splay from the other end. The wood is polished. [JC [OPS Move] 22/3/2017]
Headrest or stool, carved from a single piece of wood. Rectangular seat and two legs, decorated with solder. [EH [OPS Move] 17/3/2017]

Three-legged wooden headrest with curved rectangular, saddle-like seat, carved from a single piece of wood. The legs are cylindrical and splay from a central point on the seat. [JC [OPS Move] 22/3/2017]
'Wheel' trap for antelope: a large number of sharpened sticks bound in a ring so that their points meet at the centre of the circle.  [SM  27/11/2007]

Three-legged headrest made from one piece of wood. The seat is curved, rectangular and saddle-like. One cylindrical leg extends down from near one end, another leg extends down from the opposite end before forking into two. Around these two a strip of leather is tied. The wood is polished. [JC [OPS Move] 22/3/2017]
Headrest or stool, carved from a single piece of wood. Oval shaped seat and two legs, decorated with chevrons of tin solder. [EH [OPS Move] 17/3/2017]
Headrest or stool, carved from a single piece of wood. Curved rectangular seat and two legs, decorated with solder. [EH [OPS Move] 17/3/2017]

Wooden stool with round seat and three flaring legs, carved from single piece of wood. A carrying loop of plaited hide is tied round the tops of the legs. The plait is tied together with metal wire. There are traces of red paint on the base of the feet. [RH [OPS Move] 10/4/2017]

Wooden headrest or stool with a small seat and two legs carved from a single piece of wood. The legs are decorated with ?tin and copper alloy solder dots and a leather thong is strung between the legs with five metal and two copper alloy rings. [RH [OPS Move] 10/4/2017]

Headrest carved from single piece of wood. It comprises a curved rectangular saddle-like seat, a flat, flaring support and a circular base shaped like an inverted cup. The support is perforated in two places and a strip of metal is threaded through the two holes as a handle. [JC [OPS Move] 22/3/2017]
Pedestal headrest carved from a single piece of wood with round concave base, flat flaring stem and bi-lobed flat top.  [SM (Verve) 12/02/2014]

Wooden headrest. It comprises a curved rectangular seat, lenticular-sectioned flaring support and oval base. A rectangular metal handle is riveted to the support. The wood is polished. [JC [OPS Move] 22/3/2017]

Wooden headrest with hide lashing and interwoven section between legs. Rectangular, curved seat with two diagonal legs. The legs are bound in leather with the entire area between the legs filled with hide weaving. There two blue beads woven into the hide at the apex of the woven section.  [MOBB [OPS move] 21/3/2017]

Three legged wooden headrest.  It has a curved, rectangular, saddle-like seat, from the underside of which the stem extends down before splitting into three cylindrical legs which splay and flare at the base. Around the stem is a carrying loop of leather bound with metal wire and tied with plant fibre. [JC [OPS Move] 22/3/2017]

Headrest carved from a single piece of wood, comprising a flat, bi-lobed seat, circular base, shaped like an inverted cup, and a thin wooden sheet support connecting the two. The support is perforated in two places and a carrying strip of leather is threaded through the holes and tied. [JC [OPS Move] 22/3/2017]
Two-legged headrest made from a flat strip of wood bent in two places.  [El.B 'DCF 2004-2006 What's Upstairs?' 18/11/2004]
Wooden headrest - two-legged with oval top
Wooden headrest - two-legged with oval top

Warrior's ring knife: long curved blade terminating in a ring.
Leaf-shaped ear ornament of beaten aluminium, with hook for threading through ear-lobe. Vertical slit below hook.

Necklace of a length of coiled iron wire joined with a thong. From the wire hang pendants of glass and iron beads threaded on thongs.  Each pendant ends in a goat hoof.

Bracelet made from recycled copper alloy. [JMC 4/9/2019]
Warrior's ring claw with 3 pointed prongs. [SM  20/04/2007]
Necklace of oval red glass beads on a string. [N.B. 'DCF 2004-2006 What's Upstairs?' 28/6/2005]
Neck ornament, consisting of a string of large, smooth black seeds, with a section of rougher pieces of wood strung as beads. [N.B. 'DCF 2004-2006 What's Upstairs?' 4/8/2005]
